ai_summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited reported strong H1 FY27 financial performance, with Profit After Tax growing 23% and revenue up 17% year-on-year, driven by record net client inflows and acquisitions, affirming consistent operational strength and high client trust. The company is well on track to meet its full-year guidance and strategically expanding into London and GIFT City, indicating robust growth prospects. While employee costs saw a temporary increase due to ESOPs, expected to dramatically reduce next year, and despite some Market Linked Debentures delivering slightly below *maximum* expected returns this quarter, management maintains the MLD business is scalable and safe, with no product ever resulting in capital loss.
